name: Hijikata Sakura
source:
Has a bright personality but is a person easily prone to suffering from stress and troubles.
Called out the protagonist because of him being similar to her child, however that became the reason of getting entangled in the protagonist's love.
One year ago, her husband left leaving her in debt. Presently, she is doing civil engineering in the construction field.
